attacks.claim: The judge may, where needed, accept ordinary copies of the papers. | partly: The excerpt permits ordinary copies but does not identify the antecedent of «منها» as the papers.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 21 ¶1] يجب إيداع الأوراق والسندات والوثائق التي يستند إليها الخصوم، دعما لادعاءاتهم، بأمانة ضبط الجهة القضائية، بأصولها أو نسخ رسمية منها أو نسخ مطابقة للأصل، وتبلغ للخصم. — [cpca 21 ¶2] غير أنه يجوز للقاضي قبول نسخ عادية منها، عند الاقتضاء.
attacks.change: None. Paragraph 2 opens with «غير أنه» and qualifies paragraph 1; its «منها» takes up the same antecedent as paragraph 1's «نسخ رسمية منها», namely «الأوراق والسندات والوثائق التي يستند إليها الخصوم». The statement's «the papers» is the text's own subject; paragraph 1 is already cited as b33.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which suit authorisation required is yes, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text addresses missing legally required authorisation, but does not specify a step that must have been completed before bringing the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 13 ¶3] كما يثير تلقائيا انعدام الإذن إذا ما اشترطه القانون. — chapter heading: «الفصل الأول- في شروط قبول الدعوى»
attacks.quoteRef: cpca 13 ¶3 and the heading of chapter 1 of title 1 of book 1 (store, version law-08-09); searched cpca 59 to 69 for a cure of inadmissibility (none; articles 62 and 66 concern nullity)
attacks.change: No change of effect: p14 was already interpretive and warns. The paragraph places the authorisation among the conditions of admissibility and makes the judge raise its absence, but does not say whether it must exist at filing or only by the time the judge rules. Added open point o15 (grade C) with both readings, the protective one (obtain it before filing, warn without blocking) as the rule; p14's interpretiveNote now names that open point, and checklist line k3 refers to it. The message keeps «تحقق من الحصول على الإذن قبل رفع الدعوى», which is the protective reading.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires a brief statement of facts, requests and grounds in the opening petition; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة ... — [cpca 15 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، البيانات الآتية : — [cpca 15 ¶6] 5- عرضا موجزا للوقائع والطلبات والوسائل التي تؤسس عليها الدعوى،
attacks.change: None. The claim is brought by the petition (article 14), and the petition must contain the particular on pain of inadmissibility in form (article 15), so the particular is due by the moment the claim is brought, for every claim. That is what p5 tests on the draft before the clean export, and its message says only that the petition must contain the statement. The words «a prior step must have been taken» are the support check's generic rendering of a prior step, not words of the record.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which foreign language documents is yes, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires documents to be submitted in Arabic or with an official Arabic translation; it does not require a step completed before bringing the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 8 ¶2] يجب أن تقدم الوثائق والمستندات باللغة العربية أو مصحوبة بترجمة رسمية إلى هذه اللغة، تحت طائلة عدم القبول.
attacks.change: None. «مصحوبة» ties the translation to the document at the moment it is submitted; p15 applies only when foreign-language documents are filed in support of the claim, and its message asks only that each carries an official translation. It claims no step before the claim beyond that, and it is interpretive and warns on the sanction's reach (open point o3).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires the plaintiff's name and domicile in the petition; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة ... — [cpca 15 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، البيانات الآتية : — [cpca 15 ¶3] 2- اسم ولقب المدعي وموطنه،
attacks.change: None. Every claim is brought by the petition, which must contain the plaintiff's name, surname and domicile on pain of inadmissibility in form; p2 tests exactly that particular of the draft. The «prior step» wording is the support check's rendering of the item type.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires identification of the court in the petition; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة ... — [cpca 15 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، البيانات الآتية : — [cpca 15 ¶2] 1 - الجهة القضائية التي ترفع أمامها الدعوى،
attacks.change: None. The court must be named in the petition by which every claim is brought, on pain of inadmissibility in form; p1 tests that particular of the draft and claims nothing more.

attacks.claim: The judge also raises of his own motion the absence of an authorisation where the law requires it. | partly: The excerpt does not identify the subject of «يثير» as the judge.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 13 ¶2] يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الصفة في المدعي أو في المدعى عليه. — [cpca 13 ¶3] كما يثير تلقائيا انعدام الإذن إذا ما اشترطه القانون.
attacks.change: None. Paragraph 3 opens with «كما» («likewise») and repeats the verb «يثير تلقائيا» of paragraph 2, whose subject is «القاضي»; the subject of paragraph 3 is the same judge. Paragraph 2 is already cited as b2.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text prescribes the petition's form and filing, and conditions for formal nullity; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة، موقعة ومؤرخة، تودع بأمانة الضبط من قبل المدعي أو وكيله أو محاميه، بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف.
attacks.change: None. Every claim is brought by a petition that is written, signed and dated; p7 tests that form on the draft. It is interpretive and warns, because article 14 states no sanction and article 60 allows no nullity for form without a text (open point o1); the record claims no more than the text.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which plaintiff acts through representative is yes, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text addresses representatives' capacity or authority and correction of nullity, including during proceedings; it does not prescribe a step completed before bringing the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ... تودع بأمانة الضبط من قبل المدعي أو وكيله أو محاميه ... — [cpca 64 ¶1] حالات بطلان العقود غير القضائية والإجراءات من حيث موضوعها محددة على سبيل الحصر فيما يأتي : — [cpca 64 ¶3] 2 - انعدام الأهلية أو التفويض لممثل الشخص الطبيعي أو المعنوي. — [cpca 66 ¶1] لا يقضى ببطلان إجراء من الإجراءات القابلة للتصحيح، إذا زال سبب ذلك البطلان بإجراء لاحق أثناء سير الخصومة.
attacks.change: None. The filing of the petition by an agent is itself a procedure (article 14), and article 64 makes a representative's lack of authority a ground of its nullity; the authority is therefore due when the agent files. The record already takes account of the cure during the proceedings: p11 is interpretive, cites articles 62 and 66 and warns, never blocks (open point o11).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which dispute concerns real property is yes, the petition must be published at the land registry. | partly: The publication requirement is supported, but completion before bringing the claim is not stated. The text requires production at the first called hearing and provides the qualification «ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار».
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 17 ¶3] يجب إشهار عريضة رفع الدعوى لدى المحافظة العقارية، إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر طبقا للقانون، وتقديمها في أول جلسة ينادى فيها على القضية، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار.
attacks.change: None. The record does not say publication must be complete before the claim is brought: p17's own slot asks whether the petition «أشهرت ... أو أودعت لديها للإشهار», its message repeats the production at the first hearing and the proof of deposit, and its interpretiveNote says the publication follows the writing of the petition, so a missing publication at the drafting stage warns and never blocks (open point o9).

attacks.claim: The subject of the dispute may be changed by incidental requests linked to the original claims. | partly: The excerpt permits amendment through related incidental requests, but does not identify the object of «تعديله» as the subject of the dispute.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 25 ¶1] يتحدد موضوع النزاع بالادعاءات التي يقدمها الخصوم في عريضة افتتاح الدعوى ومذكرات الرد. — [cpca 25 ¶2] غير أنه يمكن تعديله بناء على تقديم طلبات عارضة، إذا كانت هذه الطلبات مرتبطة بالادعاءات الأصلية.
attacks.change: None. Paragraph 2 opens with «غير أنه» and qualifies paragraph 1; the pronoun of «تعديله» takes up «موضوع النزاع», the only masculine singular noun paragraph 1 makes its subject. Paragraph 1 is already cited as b49.

attacks.claim: A person who lacks or has diminished capacity is represented by law by a guardian, a tutor or a curator. | partly: Representation is stated for incapacity arising from minority, insanity, mental impairment or prodigality. The text does not expressly extend this rule to incapacity from every possible cause.
attacks.verifierQuote: [family-code 81 ¶1] من كان فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها لصغر السن، أو جنون، أو عته، أو سفه، ينوب عنه قانونا ولي، أو وصي أو مقدم طبقا لأحكام هذا القانون.
attacks.change: b36 says now names the four causes the paragraph lists: «ينوب قانونا عن فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها لصغر السن أو جنون أو عته أو سفه ولي أو وصي أو مقدم» / «... because of minority, insanity, imbecility or prodigality ...». p10's message, which restated b36, says the same in both languages. p10's rule and effect are unchanged: it rests also on cpca 64 ¶2 («انعدام الأهلية للخصوم»), which names no cause, and its slot question already lists the causes. Worked example ex37 added (an adult defendant of unsound mind, no curator named: p10 blocks).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text prescribes the petition's form and filing, and conditions for formal nullity; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة، موقعة ومؤرخة، تودع بأمانة الضبط من قبل المدعي أو وكيله أو محاميه، بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف.
attacks.change: None. The petition by which every claim is brought is filed in as many copies as there are parties; p8 tests that on the draft, is interpretive and warns, since article 14 states no sanction (open point o1).

attacks.claim: A divorce request by a spouse of diminished capacity is made in his name by his guardian or curator. | partly: The excerpt does not identify «الطلب» as a divorce request.
attacks.verifierQuote: heading: «الفصل الأول - في قسم شؤون الأسرة / القسم الثالث - في إجراءات الطلاق / الفرع الثاني - في طلب الطلاق من أحد الزوجين» — [cpca 436 ¶1] ترفع دعوى الطلاق من أحد الزوجين أمام قسم شؤون الأسرة، بتقديم عريضة وفقا للأشكال المقررة لرفع الدعوى. — [cpca 437 ¶1] عندما يكون الزوج ناقص الأهلية، يقدم الطلب باسمه، من قبل وليه أو مقدمه، حسب الحالة.
attacks.quoteRef: cpca 436 ¶1 and 437 ¶1 with the heading of their branch (store, version law-08-09)
attacks.change: None. Article 437 sits in the branch «في طلب الطلاق من أحد الزوجين» and follows article 436 on the divorce claim of one spouse; «الطلب» is that divorce request. Article 436 is already cited as b38.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires reference to supporting documents only «عند الاقتضاء». It does not state an unconditional step that must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 15 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، البيانات الآتية : — [cpca 15 ¶7] 6- الإشارة، عند الاقتضاء، إلى المستندات والوثائق المؤيدة للدعوى.
attacks.change: None. The record does not treat the reference as unconditional: p6 is interpretive, its interpretiveNote says that under «عند الاقتضاء» a missing reference is not always a defect, its message asks for the reference «إذا كانت الدعوى تستند إلى وثائق», and it warns, never blocks; the two readings are open point o13.

attacks.claim: A guardian must obtain the judge's permission to sell, partition or mortgage the minor's real property and to make a settlement. | partly: The excerpt does not identify the person required to seek permission as a guardian, or identify the real property as belonging to a minor.
attacks.verifierQuote: [family-code 88 ¶1] على الولي أن يتصرف في أموال القاصر تصرف الرجل الحريص ويكون مسؤولا طبقا لمقتضيات القانون العام. — [family-code 88 ¶2] وعليه أن يستأذن القاضي في التصرفات التالية: — [family-code 88 ¶3] 1 – بيع العقار، وقسمته، ورهنه، وإجراء المصالحة؛
attacks.change: None. «وعليه» in paragraph 2 refers back to «الولي» of paragraph 1, and the acts listed are acts on «أموال القاصر» that paragraph 1 entrusts to him (paragraph 6 speaks of «عقار القاصر» in the same list). b52 serves only as an instance of a required authorisation for open point o2.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken, except when: The text reserves the cases where the law provides otherwise, legal aid among them. | partly: The exceptions are supported, but the text makes fee payment a prerequisite to registering the petition. It does not expressly require a step completed before bringing the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 17 ¶1] لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك.
attacks.change: None. The record says what the text says: p9's message is «لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا»; its slot asks whether the fees were paid at the filing; its interpretiveNote says the stated consequence is non-registration, not inadmissibility, and that the fees are paid at the filing, after the draft is written; it warns, never blocks (open point o8).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which party is legal person is yes, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires identifying particulars for a legal person in the petition; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 15 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، البيانات الآتية : — [cpca 15 ¶5] 4- الإشارة إلى تسمية وطبيعة الشخص المعنوي، ومقره الاجتماعي وصفة ممثله القانوني أو الاتفاقي،
attacks.change: None. The particulars are due in the petition by which the claim is brought (cpca 14 ¶1), on pain of inadmissibility in form; p4 tests them on the draft when a party is a legal person and claims nothing more.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text states standing and interest requirements and rules on inadmissibility; it does not prescribe an action that must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 13 ¶1] لا يجوز لأي شخص، التقاضي ما لم تكن له صفة، وله مصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون. — [cpca 13 ¶2] يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الصفة في المدعي أو في المدعى عليه.
attacks.change: None. The record prescribes no action: p12's message and slot ask whether the plaintiff has standing, which «لا يجوز ... التقاضي ما لم تكن له صفة» makes a condition of litigating at all; the item is interpretive and warns (open point o12).

attacks.claim: The single petition gives the court, the spouses' particulars, the date and place of the marriage, the number of minor children and a brief statement of their agreement on the consequences of divorce. | partly: The number of minor children is required «عند الاقتضاء»; the statement omits that condition.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 429 ¶4] 3 - تاريخ ومكان زواجهما، وعند الاقتضاء، عدد الأولاد القصر، — [cpca 429 ¶5] 4 - عرض موجز يتضمن جميع شروط الاتفاق الحاصل بينهما حول توابع الطلاق.
attacks.change: b46 says now carries the condition and the full fourth particular: «... وتاريخ ومكان الزواج، وعند الاقتضاء عدد الأولاد القصر، وعرضا موجزا يتضمن جميع شروط اتفاقهما على توابع الطلاق» / «... where applicable the number of minor children, and a brief statement of all the terms of their agreement ...». No condition or effect changes: b46 feeds boundary n2 only. Worked example ex38 added (a childless couple who both consent, drafted as one spouse's petition: n2 warns, n3 none, doc5 listed).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text states standing and interest requirements and defines inadmissibility; it does not prescribe an action that must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 13 ¶1] لا يجوز لأي شخص، التقاضي ما لم تكن له صفة، وله مصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون.
attacks.change: None. The record prescribes no action: p13 asks whether the plaintiff has a present or potential interest recognised by law, which the paragraph makes a condition of litigating; the item is interpretive and warns (open point o12).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text requires the defendant's name and domicile, or last known domicile, in the petition; it does not state that a step must have been completed before bringing every claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة ... — [cpca 15 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، البيانات الآتية : — [cpca 15 ¶4] 3- اسم ولقب وموطن المدعى عليه، فإن لم يكن له موطن معلوم، فآخر موطن له،
attacks.change: None. The particular is due in the petition by which every claim is brought, on pain of inadmissibility in form; p3 tests it on the draft. (The text says «آخر موطن له», without «known», as checklist line k7 notes.)

attacks.claim: A petition before the administrative court must contain the particulars required of an opening petition before the ordinary court. | partly: The text requires the particulars specified in article 15, but does not identify the administrative-court scope or state that article 15 concerns an ordinary-court petition.
attacks.verifierQuote: heading of cpca 815 to 816: «الكتاب الرابع - في الإجراءات المتبعة أمام الجهات القضائية الإدارية / الباب الأول - في الإجراءات المتبعة أمام المحاكم الإدارية / الفصل الثاني - في الدعوى / القسم الأول - في رفع الدعوى» — [cpca 816 ¶1] يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى البيانات المنصوص عليها في المادة 15 من هذا القانون. — [cpca 14 ¶1] ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة بعريضة مكتوبة ...
attacks.quoteRef: cpca 816 ¶1 with its section heading; cpca 14 ¶1 and 15 ¶1, chapter «في عريضة افتتاح الدعوى» (store)
attacks.change: None. The heading places article 816 in the procedure before the administrative courts; the article 15 it names lists the particulars of the opening petition of the chapter whose article 14 brings the claim «أمام المحكمة», the ordinary first-instance court. The statement's two points are the text's.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which party lacks capacity is yes, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The text states capacity-related nullity and statutory representation rules; it does not prescribe a step that must have been completed before bringing the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: [cpca 64 ¶1] حالات بطلان العقود غير القضائية والإجراءات من حيث موضوعها محددة على سبيل الحصر فيما يأتي : — [cpca 64 ¶2] 1 - انعدام الأهلية للخصوم، — [cpca 65 ¶1] يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الأهلية ... — [family-code 81 ¶1] من كان فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها لصغر السن، أو جنون، أو عته، أو سفه، ينوب عنه قانونا ولي، أو وصي أو مقدم طبقا لأحكام هذا القانون.
attacks.change: None. The petition is the first procedure of the case, and article 64 makes a party's lack of capacity a ground of nullity of procedures, which the judge must raise (article 65); the representation of article 81 is therefore due when the petition is filed, which is what p10 checks on the draft. Its message now names the four causes of article 81 (see sup-42).
